description: VERT M6.2 Mamuju_Majene Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Erica Fischer, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). On January 14, 2021 at 2:28am local time a M6.2 earthquake occurred on the west coast of Sulawesi island near Mamuju, Indonesia. The epicenter was about 6 km northeast of Majene with a recorded intensity of VIII. A smaller earthquake (M5.7) occurred in the same area the day before (January 14). Coverage: Sulawesi, Indonesia. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Virtual Reconnaissance, Earthquake, Hospitals, Soft story building. Published 2021-01-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
